name: @pdfshush/api
description: PDFShush server pipeline: Express API + BullMQ workers for the heavy PDF tools.

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --packages=external --alias:@pdfshush/pdf-core/node=../../packages/pdf-core/src/node.ts --alias:@pdfshush/ai-provider=../../packages/ai-provider/src/index.ts --alias:@pdfshush/api-contracts=../../packages/api-contracts/src/index.ts --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild src/worker/host.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --packages=external --alias:@pdfshush/pdf-core/node=../../packages/pdf-core/src/node.ts --alias:@pdfshush/api-contracts=../../packages/api-contracts/src/index.ts --outfile=dist/worker-host.js && esbuild src/worker/processor.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --packages=external --alias:@pdfshush/pdf-core/node=../../packages/pdf-core/src/node.ts --alias:@pdfshush/api-contracts=../../packages/api-contracts/src/index.ts --footer:js="module.exports = processJob;" --outfile=dist/processor.cjs
